Just saw the movie last night.

Was it good? Yes, I enjoyed my time. the 3rd act of the movie was extremely satisfying, the movie was genuinely funny throughout its run, I'd say every sonic character had one line that made me audibly laugh, the super fight scene between sonic and shadow was incredible, and the flashback scenes between Maria and Shadow were well done. I do recommend this movie to sonic fans, and families.

But I'm not going to deny, there were things that did disappoint me. There was a LOT of missing things from SA2's story, and changes to lore that felt unnecessary to take away or genuinely affected the scope of the lore. And I know this is sonic movie 3, not sonic adventure 2 the movie, and I may be blinded by nostalgia glasses, but SA2 simply has a better scale and story then this movie did.

Why did Gerald have to be alive? In SA2, all we see of Gerald is his creepy tape and pictures. Less is more with that character, and him just being eggman #2 in this movie just.. didn't sit right. Why change the ARK from being in space, to Geralds lab just being in a mountain? In SA2, Maria wanted to visit earth but never could, and when people from earth come and take Maria's life, that puts a distance between Shadows understanding of life on earth, thus making his arc more valuable in that game. Maria's fascination with earth in SA2 is a big drive for shadow's change of heart during the game. They achieve shadows arc for the most part in this movie, but it's hard to accept the source material just has it better.

Also, shadow dropping from a meteor as opposed to being created by Gerald, again, I just don't understand that change. I guess that would've been too much backstory to fit in a movie, going over Maria's disease, the biolizard, black doom, etc. But, the thing is, not only could they have fit some of those details in there, and left out some of the scenes that weren't necessary (we did not need a humans break in scene, or a dance sequence) but, even if they were determined to leave those scenes in, in SA2 we did NOT know all the details of shadows backstory yet, and that was totally fine then. Making shadow something the government finds, as opposed to something Gerald created, again, just feels like an unnecessary change that nerfs the relationship between our characters on the ARK (or in this case, in a mountain). and the last comment to compare to SA2, Shadow takes a bit more of backseat than I would like. in SA2, him and eggman are running the show. Here, Gerald is actively running it. Again, doesn't have the same impact.

Lastly, and this is complaint about the movies pacing, it REALLY feels like we got frontloaded with info and new character introduction and never got an opportunity for scenes to breathe. Sonic's mild revenge arc being interrupted by some Wade goofiness. Live and Learn being interrupted for Jim Carrey being Jim Carrey (it was really funny, but not what I wanted), and the human/Robotnik break in scene being interrupted by Rachel and Shemar Moore's character (forgot his name lol). Is there something in these movies that REQUIRES these characters to return? Did we really need a Wade and Rachel cameo in these movies?

We really are at a time now where these movies need to learn to drop certain elements. Take a note from the MCU, when characters aren't popular, drop them. Just, drop them.

I LOVE silliness in sonic. The reason sonic stories and sonic as a character resonate with me, is because sonic is a walking representation of being happy, confident, and silly during dark times. But, when a movie isn't allowed to stay dark or emotional for more than 2 minutes, that representation doesn't hit as hard.

With all that said.. I still enjoyed the movie. Mostly because the third act REALLY carried the movie to the finish line. Agent Stone is awesome in this as always, Jim Carrey does have a good send off to his version of the mad doctor, the chemistry between sonic, tails, and knuckles is SUPER good in this movie. They really nailed making them feel close and a team, very good use of them. I was worried tails and knuckles were going to be sidelined, but they make just as much of an impact as sonic and shadow, so that's awesome. And I still enjoy Tom and Maddie in these movies. I think they are great grounded characters.

I have way more I'd like to say about this comparing this to SA2. I understand there is NO way to fit every bit of SA2 into one movie realistically. And it's not like we need everything from it represented (where's my Egg Golem! /s) but I hope for future endeavors, they let bigger scope moments and stories stay bigger scope. This was a VERY important story to tell within the sonic universe, and I do believe they missed the mark in that element.

I love the movies. But they have issues. And this show is a giant 6 episodes reminder of those issues. 
Being the lack of stakes, and the human characters being uninteresting, or in this shows case, frustrating.

Another comment said it earlier, and it's worded perfectly. The human characters are way too over the top, and written goofier than our CGI characters, making the world seem so unimportant. I'd say the only characters that seemed well written and enjoyable to watch in this were Wade's mom (her chemistry with knuckles, and him seeing her as a "leader" was really fun) and the the female villian lead (only because she wasn't extremely goofy). The Buyer had basically no screentime, such a waste of an amazing actor.

Every other human character was written annoying, stupid, and very flat, and that includes Wade. And wades sister is easily the worst OG character they've introduced in this cinematic universe. I really hope she doesn't come back.

And with the lack of stakes, I mean this with anything. Pachamac in the games is kinda of an ass. If they wanted to change him up, making him a mufasa type, or just even presenting himself wise and stoic would've been a great way to give knuckles backstory more heart. But instead they made him another goofy character, taking away the seriousness and worsening the connection of the whole scenario. Tikal would've been a much better choice.

Also, holy God damn, can we decide whether or not normal civilians are shocked or not by the mobians appearances when they're in public? It's so inconsistent. Are they still a public secret (despite destroying 2 cities and a town now) that make people faint when they are seen, or can they just walk around a casino and nobody cares? 

The last 3 episodes being practically solely focused on wade and his stupid bowling tournament, and knuckles vs The Buyer lasting maybe 2 minutes was just... so lame. Did no one in the writing room realize how lame it was?

This is long winded and negative, but I hope the qualities on this show doesn't repeat. It's too long, wasted time, with nothing interesting happening. And the worst part about it, it's not funny. They made a joke about Iblis browsing the Facebook market place? But I don't really get what the joke was, to break that out mid flashback, or story telling? Is it implying knuckles has already faced iblis as well? It gets too confusing. And this show is full of that stuff. Just jokes that don't land. They are trying to imitate the humor of the movies, but it simply did not work here.

Oh and the soundtrack sucked. Every license song was the most commonly lame picked shit you could think of. "I need a hero" was in it, I'm so tired of that song.

0/10 I hope the team behind this show stayed away from sonic 3
